footer_description: Explore thousands of movies and series. Discover the latest releases, classics and hidden gems from your favorite platforms.
privacy_collect_text: Cinevora does not collect any personally identifiable data. We only use session cookies to remember your language preferences.
privacy_usage_text: Language preferences are stored in your browser session and are not shared with third parties.
privacy_cookies_text: We use essential session cookies for the site to function. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy_thirdparty_text: Movie and series data is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). Images are hosted on TMDB servers. Please refer to TMDB's privacy policy for more information.
privacy_contact_text: For any privacy-related questions, you can contact us through the information available on this site.
terms_acceptance_text: By accessing Cinevora, you agree to be bound by these terms of service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the site.
terms_service_text: Cinevora is a movie and series discovery platform. We do not offer any video streaming content. All information comes from the TMDB API.
terms_content_text: The information, images and metadata displayed on this site are the property of their respective owners and are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB).
terms_liability_text: Cinevora is provided "as is". We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the information presented.
terms_changes_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect upon publication on this site.
dmca_intro_text: Cinevora respects intellectual property rights. If you believe that content displayed on this site infringes your copyright, please let us know.
dmca_notice_text: To submit a DMCA takedown notice, please provide: a description of the protected content, the URL of the content in question, your contact information and a good faith statement.
dmca_counter_text: If you believe your content was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notification with the information required by law.
dmca_contact_text: For any DMCA requests, please contact us through the information available on this site.
data_provided_by_justwatch: Data provided by JustWatch. Availability may vary by region.
